SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE joined_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS new_member_count,
( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS unique_visitor_count,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) AS total_attendance_count,
( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE status IN ( 'COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED' ) AND paid_at >= #{startDate} AND paid_at < DATE_ADD( #{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) AS gross_sales,
( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND refunded_at >= #{startDate} AND refunded_at < DATE_ADD( #{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) AS refund_amount,
( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE status IN ( 'COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED' ) AND paid_at >= #{startDate} AND paid_at < DATE_ADD( #{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) - ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND refunded_at >= #{startDate} AND refunded_at < DATE_ADD( #{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY ) ) AS net_sales

WITH RECURSIVE statistics_date AS ( SELECT #{startDate} AS statistics_date
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_ADD(statistics_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM statistics_date WHERE statistics_date < #{endDate} ),
member_daily AS ( SELECT joined_at AS statistics_date, COUNT(*) AS new_member_count FROM members WHERE joined_at BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY joined_at ),
attendance_daily AS ( SELECT attendance_date AS statistics_date, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS unique_visitor_count FROM attendances WHERE attendance_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY attendance_date ),
payment_daily AS ( SELECT DATE(paid_at) AS statistics_date, SUM(amount) AS gross_sales FROM payments WHERE status IN ( 'COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED' ) AND paid_at >= #{startDate} AND paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(paid_at) ),
refund_daily AS ( SELECT DATE(refunded_at) AS statistics_date, SUM(amount) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND refunded_at >= #{startDate} AND refunded_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(refunded_at) )
SELECT d.statistics_date, COALESCE(m.new_member_count, 0) AS new_member_count, COALESCE(a.unique_visitor_count, 0) AS unique_visitor_count, COALESCE(a.attendance_count, 0) AS attendance_count, COALESCE(p.gross_sales, 0) AS gross_sales, COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE(p.gross_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS net_sales FROM statistics_date d LEFT JOIN member_daily m ON m.statistics_date = d.statistics_date LEFT JOIN attendance_daily a ON a.statistics_date = d.statistics_date LEFT JOIN payment_daily p ON p.statistics_date = d.statistics_date LEFT JOIN refund_daily r ON r.statistics_date = d.statistics_date ORDER BY d.statistics_date

WITH product_sales_events AS ( SELECT mm.product_id, p.id AS payment_id, p.amount AS gross_sales, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(19, 2)) AS refund_amount FROM payments p JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = p.member_membership_id WHERE p.status IN ( 'COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'REFUNDED' ) AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD( #{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY )
UNION ALL
SELECT mm.product_id, NULL AS payment_id, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(19, 2)) AS gross_sales, r.amount AS refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.id = r.payment_id JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = p.member_membership_id WHERE r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.refunded_at >= #{startDate} AND r.refunded_at < DATE_ADD( #{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY ) )
SELECT mp.id AS product_id, mp.name AS product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_event.payment_id) AS payment_count, COALESCE( SUM(sales_event.gross_sales), 0 ) - COALESCE( SUM(sales_event.refund_amount), 0 ) AS net_sales, 0 AS sales_ratio FROM product_sales_events sales_event JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = sales_event.product_id GROUP BY mp.id, mp.name ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 5
